title: Cad Play Per Model Interactions
description: Wire interaction sessions and window engagement for every spatial play quad pane (shape, building, energy, structure-classic), not only shape.
summary: Fixed CAD play box interaction freezing after the first preview point. Root causes: (1) ShellModeCanvas rebuilt fresh viewport children whenever window engagement synced, remounting InteractionRepl/GL and discarding in-flight pointer.down; (2) GroundPickPlane ignored clicks when rubber-band move preview was on but the pick plane was disabled; (3) interactionSpatialGroundPickPlaneEnabled incorrectly required empty selectionAccept. Added resolveShellModeWindowBody cache in ShellModeCanvas, aligned GroundPickPlane click with move preview, decoupled ground pick from selection accept. Tests: cad/js/renderer (50), platform renderer (12).
